---
title: "Genetic augmentation of a clinical risk model for invasive mould disease"
subtitle: "A simulation study of incremental value: data report"
date: today
---

## The question

A validated clinical score (Stanzani et al., *J Infect* 2019) already predicts 60-day invasive mould disease
(IMD) in haematological inpatients with an aROC of 0.85. Candidate host variants in *PTX3*, *CLEC7A*
(dectin-1), *CD209* (DC-SIGN), *TLR4* and other genes are repeatedly reported as associated with invasive
aspergillosis. This project asks whether adding them to the score would change what a clinician does.

It is framed as a value-of-information question rather than a prediction-improvement exercise:

> Under what combinations of effect size, risk-allele frequency and linkage structure would host genetic
> information change clinical decisions for invasive mould disease in haematological patients, and is the
> published evidence anywhere near those combinations?

A negative answer, that no realistic genetic architecture moves the decision curve, is a finding and not a
failure. The primary endpoint is decision-curve net benefit at the 5% threshold, judged against a minimum
clinically important difference fixed before any genetic result exists.



## Where the project stands

| Phase | State |
|---|---|
| 0 Set-up | complete |
| 1 Literature search | complete: 831 unique records screened (the PubMed search date is still to be recorded) |
| 2 Screening and extraction | round 1 complete, including targeted recovery and supplementary files. Human round-2 checks are reported complete, but the record is not yet in the repository. Direction check of the text-parsed rows closed: 43 rows corrected in all, each with its evidence |
| 3 Parameter derivation | done provisionally for PTX3, CLEC7A (two parameters), TLR4 and CD209; IL10 and IFNG dropped (D14) |
| 4 Baseline | done: refit on the base cohort of 4,078 unique admissions in 1,945 patients (D9, D10), MCID +0.00458 at 5% and +0.00160 at 20%; the published equation, the 4,127 rows and the copula are sensitivity analyses |
| 5 Genetic layer simulation | first results in (addenda 11 to 22): exact layer, sampling variability, correlation ensemble, attribution, sensitivity cohorts, donor genotype in the allo-HSCT stratum, Aim 3b, the second CLEC7A parameter, the East Asian check and the tertiary NRI comparison |
| 6 Sensitivity and architecture sweep | Aim 4 sweep done (exact, and with estimated weights) and sensitivity analyses done. Still to do: the pathogen-specificity scenario, and the Aim 3b interaction test on the sensitivity cohorts |
| 7 Write-up | full first draft ([Draft manuscript](manuscript.qmd)); author list, ethics, data-availability statement and two references still to add |
